text:
Maya (CFO): Quick company-wide note: year-end vendor consolidation + invoice true-up. Please read carefully  this affects renewals and any invoices submitted between Nov 1Dec 15. We need all spend mapped to FY25 purchase orders where possible.

Lina (Finance Ops): TL;DR: before Dec 15: attach PO or project tag to every invoice; invoices > $10k require two-step approval (Procurement + Finance). Missing PO will be placed on hold and AP will not pay until resolved. Link to checklist: https://intra.redwood.com/finance/year-end-trueup :spiral_calendar:

Hector (Procurement): Operational notes: if you have a vendor with >$25k annual run-rate we want to consolidate to master agreements where possible. Submit consolidation requests to procure@redwood.com with vendor name, current POs, and preferred payment terms. We'll prioritize vendors that touch Dedicated infra or have data access.

Juno (Eng): We've got a vendor invoice stuck in AP hold (Vendor: VectorBench). Any tips to expedite?

APBot: Automated: Invoice #VB-4987 flagged for missing PO. Current status: HOLD. Please attach PO or submit procure@redwood.com with justification to release hold.

Lina (Finance Ops): Juno  we found the invoice is for a postpaid bench session billed as a single invoice $6,200. Since this is >$5k it needs PO+procurement approval per recent policy. If this was an emergency production unblock, reply here with subject "PROC EMERGENCY" and cc oncall-finance@redwood.com. Otherwise please ask Procurement for a retro-PO with justification.

Hector (Procurement): For retro-POs we need a short note: scope, reason for retro signing, project tag, and whether vendor had prior onboarding. Example email body we accept: 
```
Vendor: VectorBench
Amount: $6,200
Project: RED-DED-BENCH
Reason: short-term eval for perf regression triage; vendor not onboarded due to time box
Request: retro-PO + onboarding (Tier B)
```
Send to procure@redwood.com and add procurement@redwood.com to the invoice email thread. Retro-POs are limited and will be approved case-by-case.

Ari (Sales Ops): Quick Q: customer-facing trial credits billed via third-party vendors. Are those considered vendor spend needing PO?

Maya (CFO): If the spend is >$2k or billed monthly we want a PO. For one-off promo credits under $2k, card use is OK but tag as "sales-promo" and add customer name in notes. We'll reconcile in the FY25 bookings true-up.

LegalBot: Reminder: any consolidation that changes data processing or adds subprocessors requires Legal review. Submit the Contract Intake form and Tag "legal-review" in the Procure request. No vendor signing until Legal clears.

Juno (Eng): Thanks  submitted the retro-PO request with the template. Any estimate on how long holds take to clear?

APBot: Auto: Retro-PO requests are triaged in 24-48 business hours. If Procurement marks as urgent and Finance approves, payment release target is 3 business days post-approval.

Lina (Finance Ops): Note on tagging: required fields on invoices and expense lines are: 
```
project_code=RED-XXXX
cost_center=team-xxx
deployment_tag=hosted|dedicated|private
```
Invoices missing these will be auto-flagged. Use the Attachments field in AP portal or add in Procurely notes.

Maya (CFO): Finally  budget guidance: hold off on non-essential vendor renewals until we complete consolidation review. If a renewal is critical, mark it "renewal-critical" in the Procure request and include business impact. We'll fast-track these.

Hector (Procurement): We're scheduling vendor consolidation office hours next Wed 2pm PT. Bring lists of vendors you're proposing to consolidate. We'll share a migration template.

Maya (CFO): Summary: deadline Dec 15 for PO/tagging on invoices; >$10k invoices need dual approval; retro-PO process exists but limited; consolidate high-runrate vendors; Legal sign-off for subprocessor changes. Reach out to procure@redwood.com or finance@redwood.com with questions. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
